text:
[RARC.5.5.4.1] Time-bound LHS tests (`t.dwell > 5_min`, `no Event within
30_s`) don't naturally re-evaluate on wall-clock
passage: the network re-evaluates on fact change. So each pump retracts and
re-asserts a synthetic `$ClockTick` fact once, after its TTL sweep and before
its agenda runs, and the network's re-evaluation then re-fires the time-bound
tests at the pump's instant.
